newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel vaults with NYMEX, but liquidity thin.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel vaults with NYMEX, but liquidity thin.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices vaulted almost three cents higher in New York Harbor and 2.70 cents in the Gulf tracking NYMEX heating oil, players said.

New York Harbor 54-grade jet was offered at 1.5 cents over the print, about 0.25 cent firmer than Wednesday diffs, with Gulf diffs stable as parcels traded hands for 1.75 cents and 1.80 cents below the print, players said.
Activity, however, was razor thin, as players continued to stick to the sidelines amid confusingly higher prices.
"You can get in, but you can't get out," one Gulf trader said, sizing up the market psychology.
